title: Container Bookings: Confirming or Declining a Booking Request
content:
Every Container Bookings request that is admitted must receive an answer, either a confirmation of space or a decline, and this page sets out when each answer is given and what it brings with it.

## Policy clause

An admitted request is answered, by confirmation or by decline, no later than the product's answer time counted in hours from its receipt. A request that satisfies both the admission rules and the no-show history rule is confirmed on the sailing the customer asked for when space and equipment are available. Under a product with guaranteed space, a request that satisfies those two rules is confirmed on the requested sailing in every case. Under any other product, a request for a sailing whose space is fully allocated is declined; it is not confirmed on some other sailing, because choosing the sailing belongs to the customer.

Confirmation fixes on the booking its vessel and voyage, its scheduled departure date and its three cut-offs (cargo, shipping instructions and VGM), and it opens freight charging. A request that fails the admission conditions, or that the customer withdraws while it is still unconfirmed, is declined, and its cancellation date is set to the date of the decline. A declined request bears no charge whatsoever; neither the cancellation fee nor the no-show fee can ever attach to it.

## Branching Q&A

**The request passes both rules and the sailing has room. What follows?** Confirmation on the requested sailing.

**The request passes both rules, the sailing is fully allocated, and the product guarantees space. What follows?** Confirmation on the requested sailing all the same.

**The request passes both rules, the sailing is fully allocated, and the product does not guarantee space. What follows?** A decline; the desk does not substitute another sailing.

**The customer withdraws a request that has not been confirmed. What follows?** A decline dated on the day of withdrawal, with nothing charged.

## Status effect

A confirmation moves the booking from requested to confirmed. A decline moves it from requested to cancelled.
